description: Housekeeping fixes + core infrastructure + all 16 SQLAlchemy models. This FEAT makes the app importable and the test DB schema creatable. No services or routes yet — tests for those come in FEAT-002 and FEAT-003. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 (they depend on this one).

Create /Users/gauravshewale/Development/business/NFC/polsia/app/models/__init__.py with exactly the imports specified in plan.md section 2-A (all 16 model classes).

Create app/models/company.py: CompanyConfig mapped to table 'company_config'. All JSON fields (pricing_model, goals, kpis) use sa.JSON. Python-side default='UTC' for timezone, default=6 for daily_cycle_hour. updated_at uses onupdate=sa.func.now().

Create app/models/activity.py: ActivityLog mapped to 'activity_log'. detail uses sa.JSON. Python-side default='info' for level.
Create app/models/memory.py: MemoryEntry mapped to 'memory_entries'. tags MUST use sa.JSON (NOT postgresql.ARRAY). chroma_id has unique=True constraint.

Create app/models/social.py: SocialPost mapped to 'social_posts' (Python-side default='twitter' for platform, 'draft' for status; engagement uses sa.JSON). SocialEngagement mapped to 'social_engagements' (mention_id unique=True).

Create app/models/outreach.py: Prospect, EmailCampaign, EmailLog mapped to their tables. Python-side defaults for status and integer counters. EmailLog FKs reference 'prospects.id' and 'email_campaigns.id'.
Create app/models/ads.py: AdCampaign and AdMetric. Float columns (daily_budget_usd etc.) use Python-side default=0.0. AdMetric FK references 'ad_campaigns.id'.
Create app/models/competitors.py: Competitor. pricing_info, strengths, weaknesses ALL use sa.JSON (NOT JSONB or ARRAY — the alembic migration uses ARRAY but the ORM model must use JSON for SQLite).
Create app/models/finance.py: StripeEvent (raw_payload sa.JSON), RevenueSnapshot (snapshot_date unique Date column, all integer counters default=0), ExpenseRecord.

Create app/models/reports.py: DailyReport. BOTH metrics_snapshot and insights use sa.JSON. insights stores a list (JSON array). test_save_evening_summary checks 'report.insights == ["Referral traffic up 20%", "Support load low"]' — sa.JSON returns Python list on read.

findings: 1. TABLE COUNT IS 17 NOT 16: The spec mentions 16 models throughout but the actual model list in plan.md section 2-A has 17 imports (CompanyConfig, Task, AgentRun, ActivityLog, MemoryEntry, SocialPost, SocialEngagement, Prospect, EmailCampaign, EmailLog, AdCampaign, AdMetric, Competitor, StripeEvent, RevenueSnapshot, ExpenseRecord, DailyReport). This matches the alembic migration which also creates 17 tables. FEAT-002/003 should expect 17 tables. 2. settings.timezone ADDED: The verification script checks settings.timezone but it was not in plan.md section 1-B. A timezone field (default='Asia/Kolkata') was added to Settings to make verification pass. 3. Task.metadata RENAMED: SQLAlchemy reserves 'metadata' as a class-level attribute on DeclarativeBase. The Task model's 'metadata' column was renamed to 'task_metadata' in Python with sa.Column('metadata', sa.JSON) to preserve the DB column name. Tests don't access task.metadata directly so this is safe. 4. COLLECTION ERRORS EXPECTED AT FEAT-001 STAGE: 6 test files (test_activity_service.py, test_base_agent.py, test_company_service.py, test_memory_service.py, test_report_service.py, test_task_service.py) fail to collect because they import app.services and app.agents which don't exist yet. This is by design — FEAT-001 explicitly excludes services and agents. FEAT-002 must create app/services/ and FEAT-003 must create app/agents/ and app/api/ + app/main.py. The API tests (test_agents.py, test_config.py, test_dashboard.py, test_finance.py, test_memory.py, test_social.py, test_tasks.py) collect fine but will fail at execution time because app.main doesn't exist yet. 5. VENV CREATED: A .venv was created at project root using /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12 with requirements-dev.txt installed. This was needed for local verification since the project runs in Docker normally.
